title: Official Allowable Increase Rates
description: SF Rent Board rates effective on 2026-11-10 and historical context.

rows.notes: Relevant to Unit 2 lease start; no banked amount inferred.

rows.label: Local formula
rows.value: 60% of Bay Area CPI-U increase; max 7%

rows.label: Temporary CPI methodology
rows.notes: Jan. 13, 2026 minutes adopted Version 1 temporary methodology.

rows.label: Calculation
rows.value: Base rent x rate; no rounding up

rows.label: Proposed banked and capital-improvement cap, File 261020
rows.value: Not enacted as of November 11, 2026; proposal would temporarily limit combined banked and capital-improvement increases to 10% per year.
rows.notes: If enacted as currently proposed, applicability would include banked notices and capital-improvement petitions from September 15, 2026. Check current status; see F46.

rows.label: Effect of proposed cap on either unit
rows.notes: Not enacted and case-specific histories are unverified; do not treat the proposal as current law.

rows.label: Exact Legistar record at fetch (2026-11-11)
rows.value: Version 1; introduced 9/15/2026; in control: Land Use and Transportation Committee; STATUS 'Pending Committee Action'; final action, enactment date and enactment number all blank
rows.notes: History rows are procedural only: 9/15/2026 assigned under 30-day rule; 9/18/2026 and 9/30/2026 referred to department; 10/7/2026 Youth Commission response received.

rows.label: Proposed applicability date vs posting date
rows.value: Notice posted November 9, 2026 says the proposal would apply to banked increases noticed on or after September 15, 2026 and to capital improvement petitions filed on or after September 15, 2026; draft Sec. 37.3(h) uses the same September 15, 2026 trigger
rows.notes: The applicability date precedes both the posting date and the 9/15/2026 introduction. Nothing official says how a notice served between 9/15/2026 and enactment would be treated.

rows.label: Duration wording disagrees
rows.value: Notice: 'temporarily limit'. Legistar title: 'for the next three years'. Draft Sec. 37.3(h) states the limit remains in effect until December 31, 2029 unless extended, with excess imposable on/after January 1, 2030
rows.notes: Draft text defines the sunset; the proposal is still not enacted. See F47.

rows.label: Next-year rate (3/1/27 - 2/28/28)
rows.notes: Still not published on either official page when re-checked 2026-11-10; blank rather than estimated.

rows.label: How the proposed 10% is measured (draft text)
rows.value: 10% of the lowest base rent in effect during the 12 months preceding the effective date; proposed Sec. 37.3(h) covers Sec. 37.3(a)(2)-(3) only, leaving the Sec. 37.3(a)(1) annual CPI increase separate
rows.notes: Draft text answers measurement; still proposed, not current law. Case-specific effect remains blank (RATE-13).
